purpose: Reverse pending receiver THROW preserves one LIVE row input and a raw reference current; post-catch COW separates the retained old table without an API result snapshot.

<?php
class ReviewBufferedThrowOld38 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewBufferedThrowRowNew38 { function __destruct() { echo "C|"; } }
function &reviewBufferedThrowChild38() { global $row; $row = [new ReviewBufferedThrowOld38()]; echo "C0|"; try { $received = yield 7 => $row; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CHILD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedThrowLower38() { echo "L|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewBufferedThrowUpper38() { echo "U|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["lower"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewBufferedThrowTop38() { echo "T|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-TOP|"; } finally { echo "V|"; } }
function reviewBufferedThrowOuter38() { echo "O|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["top"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$given1 = new Exception("buffered-throw-first38"); $given2 = new Exception("buffered-throw-second38"); $child = reviewBufferedThrowChild38(); $lower = reviewBufferedThrowLower38(); $upper = reviewBufferedThrowUpper38(); $top = reviewBufferedThrowTop38(); $outer = reviewBufferedThrowOuter38();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|"; $lower->send($row); echo "S1|T1|";
try { $top->throw($given1); echo "BAD-THROW1|"; } catch (Exception $caught1) { echo "C1|", $caught1 === $given1 ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught1->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "T2|"; try { $upper->throw($given2); echo "BAD-THROW2|"; } catch (Exception $caught2) { echo "C2|", $caught2 === $given2 ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught2->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
$row[0] = new ReviewBufferedThrowRowNew38(); echo "COW|", $upper->current()[0] instanceof ReviewBufferedThrowRowNew38 ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($caught1, $caught2, $given1, $given2); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($top); echo "TOP|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|"; unset($row); echo "ROW|"; echo "E";

purpose: Same-object pending rethrow retains a present-null current and one old input array with a shared cell; post-close rebinding releases its old referent and preserves the new one.

class ReviewBufferedThrowCellNew38 { function __destruct() { echo "CNEW|"; } }
function reviewBufferedThrowNullChild38() { global $slot; $slot = new ReviewBufferedThrowCellOld38(); echo "C|"; try { $received = yield 7 => null; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } catch (Exception $caught) { echo "BAD-CHILD|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewBufferedThrowNullLower38() { echo "L|"; try { yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-LOWER|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }

$given = new Exception("buffered-throw-same38"); $child = reviewBufferedThrowNullChild38(); $lower = reviewBufferedThrowNullLower38(); $upper = reviewBufferedThrowNullUpper38(); $top = reviewBufferedThrowNullTop38(); $outer = reviewBufferedThrowNullOuter38();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|"; $lower->send([&$slot]); echo "S1|T1|";
try { $upper->throw($given); echo "BAD-THROW1|"; } catch (Exception $caught1) { echo "C1|", $caught1 === $given ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught1->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "T2|"; try { $top->throw($given); echo "BAD-THROW2|"; } catch (Exception $caught2) { echo "C2|", $caught2 === $given ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught2 === $caught1 ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught2->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; } echo "GET|", $top->current() === null ? 1 : 0, "|", $top->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($caught1, $caught2, $given); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($top); echo "TOP|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($lower); echo "LOW|"; unset($child); echo "CHILD|";
$slot = new ReviewBufferedThrowCellNew38(); echo "WRITE|"; unset($slot); echo "UNSET|"; echo "E";
